original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹伦拜克北部族群冲突致5死12伤
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹湖泊州伦拜克北部县帕卡姆社区的曼努尔与利思两个分支武装青年之间再次爆发族群冲突，造成至少5人死亡、12人受伤。冲突自周三开始，还烧毁了一处初级卫生保健站和多间茅草屋。湖泊州新闻与通信看守部长表示，州政府和县长已部署安全部队以防止事态升级。目前该消息仅来自单一来源。

key_facts.fact: 伦拜克北部族群冲突造成至少5人死亡、12人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At least five people have been killed and 12 others wounded in renewed interclan clashes between armed youths from the Manuer and Lith sections of the Pakam community in Rumbek North County, Lakes State.

key_facts.fact: 冲突自周三开始，并烧毁一处初级卫生保健站和多间茅草屋
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The clashes, which began on Wednesday, also left a primary healthcare unit burned and several thatched houses torched.

key_facts.fact: 湖泊州政府与伦拜克北部县长已部署安全部队防止冲突升级
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He said the state government and the Rumbek North County commissioner had deployed security forces to the area to prevent further escalation and a resumption of clashes.

key_facts.fact: 伤者大多被送往伦拜克州立医院
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Kirjok said most of the wounded had been taken to Rumbek State Hospital, while others were still on their way to receive treatment.

uncertainties: 伤亡数字来自湖泊州官员单一说法，尚未获得独立核实
目前仅有一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，缺乏交叉验证
